content.innerText: At Mentor, we strive to provide the best learning experience for our users. We understand that there may be situations where you may need to request a refund. This Refund Policy outlines the conditions and procedures for obtaining a refund for purchases made on our platform.
Our general refund policy applies to all courses and services offered on Mentor. Refunds will be granted under the following conditions:
If you have purchased a course and have not accessed any of its content, you may request a full refund within 14 days of the purchase date.
If you experience technical issues that prevent you from accessing the course content and we are unable to resolve the issue, you may request a refund within 14 days of the purchase date.
Certain items and services are not refundable. These include:
Any content that has been downloaded to your device is non-refundable.
If you have completed a course, it is not eligible for a refund.
To request a refund, please follow these steps:
Our support team will review your request and may contact you for additional information. We aim to process all refund requests within 5-7 business days.

If your refund request meets the conditions outlined in this policy, we will process the refund to your original method of payment. Please allow 5-10 business days for the refund to appear in your account.

Mentor reserves the right to modify this Refund Policy at any time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page. Your continued use of the platform after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the new policy.
